script_text: Your world tilts on its axis this week, Aquarius, as Uranus squares your Sun. Late week favors career moves, with Friday perfect for financial negotiations as Venus squares your 10th House ruler. Saturday brings unexpected networking opportunities, while Sunday's full Moon in your 5th House sparks romantic surprises. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Avoid major decisions on Monday when Mars squares your natal Neptune. Focus on long-term career strategy over short-term pleasures. Follow for daily updates.
